projects.title: Python Programs Collection
projects.summary: A core algorithmic Python collection featuring factorial calculations (iterative & recursive), Fibonacci sequence generator with memoization, and structure-to-dictionary conversion tools with comprehensive documentation.
projects.details: This repository showcases fundamental programming logic and data structure manipulations in Python. It includes a recursive and iterative factorial calculator with boundary validation, a Fibonacci series generator capable of dynamic memoization, an automated structure/tuple-to-dictionary transformation utility, and a clean, structured README repository guide.
highlights: Iterative & recursive factorial with integer validation
Fibonacci generator supporting n-terms and memoization
Nested data structure to Python dictionary parser
Clean PEP 8 formatting with unit examples

projects.title: Messy Python Code Improvement
projects.summary: AI-assisted transformation of unformatted, monolithic legacy Python code into clean, modular, and PEP 8-compliant functions with explicit type hinting and robust exception handling.
projects.details: Demonstrates systematic refactoring of a tangled, single-block Python script using structured prompt engineering. The refactored version breaks monoliths into single-responsibility functions, replaces magic numbers with descriptive constants, introduces type annotations, and incorporates defensive try-except blocks.
highlights: Decomposed monolithic logic into reusable functions
Added type hints (typing module) and docstrings
Standardized variable naming to PEP 8 snake_case
Safe error handling preventing unhandled crashes

projects.title: Bug Fixing Using Cursor AI
projects.summary: Targeted identification and resolution of subtle edge-case bugs, off-by-one errors, and unhandled index exceptions in algorithmic code using Cursor AI's context-aware codebase analysis.
projects.details: Highlights the practical use of Cursor AI as an intelligent pair programmer during academic lab work. By prompting the model with execution trace logs and boundary condition tests, edge-case bugs (such as zero-length input crashes and off-by-one boundary conditions) were pinpointed and resolved with surgical patches.
highlights: Identified hidden off-by-one index boundaries
Utilized Cursor AI chat with contextual prompt instructions
Added test boundary assertions to verify fix stability
Documented root-cause analysis in lab notes

projects.title: Interactive Quiz Application
projects.summary: A dynamic web quiz application developed in Lecture 10 featuring interactive Tech and General Knowledge question banks, real-time score calculation, immediate answer explanations, and progress tracking.
projects.details: Engineered during Lecture 10 practical sessions, this application presents multiple-choice questions spanning Computer Science fundamentals (CPU, HTTP, OS, AI) and General Knowledge. Features include instant visual feedback upon selection, calculated performance summaries, and keyboard-accessible navigation.
highlights: Dynamic question loading from structured dataset
Instant visual validation (green for correct, red for incorrect)
Progress bar with question counter and percentage tally
Final score recap with cheerful encouragement

projects.title: Book Reading List Application
projects.summary: A lightweight personal reading tracker developed in Lecture 11 allowing users to categorize books by status ('Want to Read', 'Currently Reading', 'Finished'), record personal ratings, and persist reading goals across browser sessions.
projects.details: Built as part of Lecture 11 practical requirements, this productivity tool empowers students to organize their reading backlog. Features include status filtering tabs, dynamic book card generation, star rating input, and automatic browser localStorage synchronization so data is never lost on refresh.
highlights: Complete CRUD operations for book entries
Filter pills for Want to Read, Reading, and Completed
Persistent client-side storage via browser localStorage
Responsive card grid with clean, calm visual hierarchy

You can search and filter them directly in the Projects section above! 💻
